about: The one source of Auracle's colors, font families, type scale, spacing, radii and motion. `make tokens` (www/brand/tokens.py) writes them into each surface's stylesheet, between `tokens:begin` and `tokens:end`; `make dev-check` fails when a block is stale, a color is written anywhere else, or a file's count of literal sizes and durations rises (www/brand/sizes-baseline.json).

type, space, radius and motion are the approved specimen's (prototype v2, docs/notes/vision-2026-09/prototype/style.css) and every surface shares them. A surface's `sizes` holds the sizes only it uses, and may restate a shared one for itself with a note (the landing page reads its prose at 1rem).

A palette holds the named tiers every surface shares. A surface holds its own named shades (a value only that surface uses) and the opacities it uses of any token: `--phos-b-30` is --phos-b at 30%, and a third digit is a tenth (`--phos-a-045` is --phos-a at 4.5%). An opacity is generated as rgba(), not color-mix(): a gradient that holds a color-mix() colour interpolates in Oklab rather than sRGB, which moved pixels.
A note is carried into the generated CSS as a comment. Contrast ratios are against the palette's ground (the rack, or paper).

silk.note: the panel's silkscreen: labels, controls, prose

mono.value: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

type.title: type: one ratio (1.2) and six roles. The steps run up from the value size, 12 × 1.2ⁿ rounded: 12, 14, 17, 21, and 52 at n = 8. Labels sit under the scale at 11 px, the floor for text in a page; the rack, drawn to its zoom, has sizes of its own, and a lone glyph is sized to its button

t-label.note: silk caps: panel labels, tabs, buttons; the floor for text

t-voice.note: the model speaking (Newsreader italic), and nothing else

t-title.note: a title: a sound's name, a card's heading, the wordmark

t-canvas.note: the smallest text drawn on a canvas (TA20 found 10 px too small)

space.title: space: a 4 px grid to 16, then wider. Under the first step (1 to 3 px) is an optical nudge, not a space, and is written as it is

radius.title: radius: three. A circle is 50% and a pill 999px, shapes rather than steps; 1 to 3 px is a hairline's rounding

r1.note: a row, a chip, a small control

r2.note: a button, a pad, a card

motion.title: motion: three durations and two easings. Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration is 0 ms. A loop's period is not one of these

d-press.note: a press: a control going down, a row lighting

d-state.note: a state changing: a color, a hover, a reveal

d-move.note: something moving: a view, a panel, a card arriving

e-swap.note: one thing giving way to another

black.note: shadow lines, the edge under a raised control, masks

white.note: highlights only, at an opacity; as ink it reads cold against silk

rack.about: The instrument's palette: the app, the landing page, the brand page, the 404, the films, and the docs' Rack theme.

groups.title: machined graphite: the two faces of every raised control and the ink of the shadow under it, one literal each, so a retune is one line

plate-hi.note: util buttons, selects: top of the face

btn-hi.note: hardware buttons and pads: top of the face

btn-hover-hi.note: the same face under a pointer: one step up

shadow-ink.note: the hard shadow line under a raised control

groups.title: shared shades: one value, used on more than one surface

rack-lo.note: below the rack: the landing page's foot, the docs' sidebar

panel-lo.note: the foot of a raised panel; the docs' quotes and search results

pop-lo.note: the foot of a floating surface and of the menu bar; the docs' pop-ups

recess-hi.note: the top of a recessed panel (bank, node bank); a screw's shadow; an empty tile

lifted.note: a lifted strip: a held tray item's top, a table's header row

amber-off.note: an unlit amber cell: pips, lock dots

steel.note: bare steel: a screw head's highlight; the docs' scrollbar

groups.title: green phosphor: sound. `-dim` is the text tier, `-deep` the stroke tier

paper.about: The docs' light theme, Paper: warm ink on stock rather than an inverted rack. It keeps the hues and re-derives the values against a light ground; the docs only.

groups.title: grounds. Warm stock rather than white: the whole palette is warm, and pure white under these hues reads blue by contrast

bezel.note: screen bezels: dark on Paper too, on purpose, as a film is

groups.title: the same two hues, re-derived against a light ground. Both clear AA for body text; the `-deep` tiers stay stroke-only

app.about: The instrument (apps/web): style.css, and main.js's canvases and rack defs.

t-rack-micro.note: the rack at zoom 1 (its camera scales all four; main.js's module geometry is sized around them): mono numerals, in/out

t-rack-value.note: …readouts, enum chips, a narrow plate's title

t-wordmark.note: the header's wordmark, spaced wide beside its lamp (Plan-008, the prototype's)

well.note: a recessed SVG well: an enum's body, a step's track

tray-jack.note: a jack's face in the rack

scrim.note: the veil under an overlay; only at an opacity

rack-bed-hi.note: the rack's ground: top (also the exported rack's)

xport-lo.note: …shadow side, and its ink when playing

recess-lo.note: the foot of a recessed panel; a knob's shadow side

crt-green.note: the green glow at a scope's centre; a tray jack's bore

crt-amber.note: the amber glow at an amber screen's centre

module-hi.note: a module plate in the rack: top

nut-hi.note: a jack nut and a screw head: lit side; a step bar under the pointer; a tray item's edge

chip.note: a style chip; a plug's boot

card-hi.note: a card: node-bank item, warm-start item, duel cell

kbd-face.note: a key cap in the ? card

plate-edge.note: the edge of a plate or well; the scrollbar's thumb

screw-rim.note: a screw's rim on the menu bar and the dock

nofit-a.note: a bank pip the model cannot score: stripe

evolve-hi.note: EVOLVE FROM THIS: top of the amber face

alarm-hi.note: an alarm toast's amber face: top

bkey-hi.note: a black key: top (the foot is --rack)

pkey-mapped-hi.note: a white key with a computer key on it: top

pkey-unmapped-hi.note: a white key without one: top

pkey-hint.note: a white key's printed computer key

landing.about: The landing page (www/landing): style.css and hero.js's traces.

t-display.note: the hero line, Jost 300 with negative tracking: an instrument panel's signage

t-micro.note: mono values in the figures, at the floor

go-hi.note: the green call to action: top

t-headline.note: the page's headline, as the landing page's display line is its own (--t-display is the specimen's 52 px)

paper-stock.note: the stock the mark is shown on, to prove the tile does not invert (not the docs' Paper)

404.about: The site's 404 page (www/404.html), styled inline because it is served at any depth.

table-stripe.note: a table's alternate row; a search result

popup.note: a pop-up, the search box, a key cap

code-ink.note: inline code: a rust between the two hues

stage.about: The film stage (www/video/stage/stage.css), which the kit and every film's film.js and cards.js read.

frame-glow.note: the frame's centre; a quote's box

slot.note: a screw's slot; a black key; an unlit pip's rim

screw-lo.note: a screw head's shadow side (the lit side is --steel)

module-face.note: a module plate in a grid of them

phos-a-pulse.note: the white-hot head of a green trace; a signal pulse

phos-b-hot.note: a walker, a head, a marker: amber, one step hotter
